details.soft: Frees space by clearing caches, temporary files, and UI layout state. Settings, credentials, and workspace data stay intact.
details.appData: Returns the app to a clean state. Settings, application state, workspace and Agentic OS runtime, installed apps, and cache are deleted. Logs, credentials, and browser profiles are kept unless selected below.
details.factory: Wipes everything Sparo OS manages, including credentials, browser profiles, custom agents, skills, and managed runtimes.

backup.label: Create a reset backup
backup.description: Copy configuration and state into a backup folder before deleting.

secrets.label: Include secrets
secrets.description: Also delete stored credentials and authorization vaults.

browser.label: Include browser profiles
browser.description: Also delete Sparo-managed browser login state and profiles.

resetDialog.title: Reset application data?
resetDialog.message: This permanently deletes the selected Sparo OS data on this device and cannot be undone. Your project source files are never touched, and the app will restart once the reset completes.

messages.resetComplete: Reset {{resetId}} completed and freed {{size}}. Restart Sparo OS before continuing.
